svg.desc: Where conversations live Four places, each with its own people and purpose. Discussion room You, Claude and GPT Results in one sentence; your questions and asks. Private chats You with Claude, you with GPT One-to-one and kept apart; never mixed into the room. Exchange notes Claude and GPT ask · answer · decide · veto; every question has a number. Events Programs to the right chat Task changes become events; an optional bridge wakes a chat.
